data.name: Fire
data.description: Kineticists who focus on the element of fire are called pyrokineticists. Pyrokineticists wield elemental fire as a potent weapon, and they possess a powerful offense.

raw_tokens.value: Kineticists who focus on the element of fire are called pyrokineticists. Pyrokineticists wield elemental fire as a potent weapon, and they possess a powerful offense.
&nl;Class Skills: A pyrokineticist adds Escape Artist and Knowledge (nature) to her list of class skills.
